recsys_serve.label: served D25-D28: served ranker + feedback loop + exploration slot (D25)

recsys_serve_noexplore.label: served ranker (no length_cap_ratio) + feedback loop, no exploration

recsys_serve_v2.label: SERVED DEFAULT (D28): recsys_serve + stated needs as constraints in front of retrieval

recsys_serve_v2_noexplore.label: recsys_serve_v2 without the exploration slot (config override)

recsys_v1_fb.label: default + feedback loop as chosen on dev (route effects + slot steps)

recsys_v1_fb_light.label: default + full light loop (slots, Rocchio, re-scoring, near-duplicates)

recsys_v1_fb_route.label: default + route effects only (completed / rejected not shown again)

v0_rules.label: baseline rule scorer, its own feedback (negative reasons only)

v1_filters.label: hard filters + rule scorer, v0's feedback mechanism
